summary: Solid, production-ready PowerShell implementation. Module design is clean with proper parameter validation (ValidateRange, ValidateSet), Set-StrictMode, and idiomatic error handling. Workflow correctly uses `shell: pwsh`, least-privilege permissions, sensible triggers (push/PR/schedule/dispatch), and pinned reference date for CI determinism. Minor issues: evaluation-gate logic (lines 91–99) convoluted—switch/exit pattern needs comments to clarify intent; test fixture/expected-value pairs tightly coupled to REFERENCE_DATE (unavoidable for integration testing); two report-generation steps repeat similar logic but acceptable for output transparency.
